remarks: Convenient and sophisticated style is what you get with this luxury 2 bedroom, 1.5 bathroom townhouse with a great 3rd bedroom option at sought after Rivers Edge complex on Darien/New Canaan border! Offering hardwood floors throughout the main level, spacious dining/living room, eat-in kitchen with granite counters, SS appliances and sliders that lead out to your private balcony perfect for Grilling/entertaining. Enjoy the large master bedroom w/ cathedral ceiling, huge walk-in closet and large windows. Head upstairs to a gorgeous loft that can be used as a 3rd bedroom, large den or playroom. Washer/dryer in unit, attached garage and an impressive amount of storage space available. Amenities include a beautiful in-ground pool, fitness center and freshly renovated clubhouse. Walk-to-all living in Springdale Village! Just about everything is a short stroll away - train, restaurants, entertainment, shopping, parks, school, library & more! 1.5mi to golf, 2mi to Merritt & 3mi to I95.
